item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: JWT validation with Azure Front Door Auth Policy
item.description:
Azure Front Door Premium now supports JWT validation in public preview through the Front Door Auth Policy. It validates Microsoft Entra ID bearer tokens at the edge before traffic reaches APIs or web applications.

  • Source: Azure Updates
